_comment: Per-project override for the verification gate, read by hooks/lib/detect-toolchain.sh.
It is the first thing checked and it beats every other detection step, so any repo whose
setup the detector guesses wrong can state the truth here.
This copy is how this config verifies itself: a contributor who ran install.sh --user has
the Stop hook globally, so working in this repo runs the suite at turn end. Without this
file the detector finds no manifest here and the gate would pass silently.
Other keys a project can set: lint, typecheck, format (a value of "" means the project has
no such command, so stop looking), gate, skip.
